mx.teacher_note: The beam bends toward the wall even though it passes beside the mirror.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: A polished steel plate cannot reflect light; only glass mirrors can.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: No reflection occurs because there is no bright spot on another surface.

intelligence.enrichment: Reflection is the change in direction of light when light falls on a mirror or shiny surface. Light falling on a mirror or shiny surface is redirected, so the path of the beam changes and a bright spot can appear elsewhere. The learner correctly applies this rule: Reflection is the change in direction of light when light falls on a mirror or shiny surface. A mirror creates its own bright spot because it is shiny.
